news.title: Meta buys robotics startup to bolster its humanoid AI ambitions
news.description: Meta bought humanoid startup Assured Robot Intelligence to beef up its AI models for robots, the company said.

news.title: Pentagon inks deals with Nvidia, Microsoft, and AWS to deploy AI on classified networks
news.description: The deals come as the DOD has doubled down on diversifying its exposure to AI vendors in the wake of its controversial dispute with Anthropic over usage terms of its AI models.

news.title: Oscars says AI actors and writing cannot win awards
news.description: The academy that controls the Oscars on Friday issued new award eligibility requirements around the use of artificial intelligence in film.

news.title: Pentagon says US military to be an 'AI-first' fighting force
news.description: The US military has agreed eight new contracts with big tech firms as it expands its artificial intelligence capabilities.

news.title: Spotify adds 'Verified' badges to distinguish human artists from AI
news.description: The music streaming platform will review criteria such as artists' live dates and social media presence.

news.title: A Dark-Money Campaign Is Paying Influencers to Frame Chinese AI as a Threat
news.description: Build American AI, a nonprofit linked to a super PAC bankrolled by executives at OpenAI and Andreessen Horowitz, is funding a campaign to spread pro-AI messaging and stoke fears about China.

news.title: How Shivon Zilis Operated as Elon Musk’s OpenAI Insider
news.description: Messages presented at trial reveal how Zilis, the mother of four of Musk’s children, acted as an intermediary between him and OpenAI.

news.title: Musk v. Altman Kicks Off, DOJ Guts Voting Rights Unit, and Is the AI Job Apocalypse Overhyped?
news.description: In this episode of Uncanny Valley, we get into how the Elon Musk-Sam Altman trial goes way beyond their rivalry and could have major implications both for OpenAI and also the AI industry at large.
